title: What to Apply After a Face Pack (Including Multani Mitti)
ex: The right order after a face pack, what to apply after multani mitti, besan, haldi and peel-off masks, and when to skip active creams that night.
rt: What to Apply After a Face Pack or Multani Mitti | Mirc Glow
rd: What to apply after a face pack: rinse, pat dry and moisturise within a minute. What to use after multani mitti, besan or haldi, and what to skip that night.
keyword: what to apply after face pack
quick: After a face pack, rinse with lukewarm water, pat dry and apply a moisturiser or night cream within a minute while skin is slightly damp. After clay packs like multani mitti, a plain soothing cream is safest; skip kojic acid or other actives that night if skin feels tight or tingly.
facts: Rinse clay packs before they crack, about 10 to 15 minutes
No second face wash needed after rinsing
Moisturise on damp skin within a minute
Clay packs once or twice a week for oily skin, less for dry
